name: Consent
description: Records patient consent for various data usage and privacy policies.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning patient — set automatically from the associated patient; only the owning patient or an admin may access.

attributes.name: patientProfileId
attributes.description: Foreign key to the PatientProfile entity.

attributes.name: consentDate
attributes.description: Date when consent was given or updated.

attributes.name: isGranted
attributes.description: True if consent is granted, false otherwise.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of the policy or terms to which consent was given.

attributes.name: policyText
attributes.description: Full text of the policy or terms consented to.
